payload.name: Preserve co-participants in event extraction
payload.description: When extracting an event from a message that explicitly names additional people who took part with the subject, include those companions in the memory content during extraction.
content: When a source message states the subject and one or more companions traveled, attended, or did an activity together, the extracted event memory must record the companions as participants, not only the subject. Preserve phrases like 'with my partner' in the memory content.

solves: During construction extraction, event summaries often drop named companions, losing relational facts required later. This rule applies whenever the source explicitly names a co-participant in a shared activity; it transfers across travel, classes, meals, and similar events.
